metadataRaw.title: Stretch Your Full Back IN SECONDS (Instant Pain, Aches and Tightness Relief)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises to stretch the entire back, offering relief within seconds.

If you're dealing with aches, pains, and tightness across your whole back and want a stretch that targets everything, definitely check out this video.

The exercises in this video target the most muscles in the shortest amount of time and may help relieve tightness, pain, and aches across the back in as little as 30 seconds.

Each exercise works differently, targeting different back muscles and shown in different positions. For the best results, go through them all and stick with the ones that give you the most relief.

Watch now and stretch your full back for instant relief from pain and tightness!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:43 Seated Forward Lean
2:48 Frog Rocker
4:52 Seated Side Lean
6:32 Ballerina
8:30 Superman (Strengthening)
